en:
Shuichi...
About before...I'm sorry for throwing you.

But it's because you're a degenerate male.
Blame yourself for being born that way.

<CLT=cltMIND>That doesn't sound like much
of an apology.

I woke up in bed...
Did you carry me back to my room, Tenko?

I didn't want to...but I couldn't just leave
you there. It was bothering me.
Ah, haha... Well, thank you.

Well... You may not have anything else going
for you, but at least you have guts.
Guts?

You still came to talk to me, even though
I threw you around like a rag doll.

You might have an ulterior motive like most
males, but you have a lot of courage.

Unless, you're one of those degenerates
who enjoys being stepped on!!!
Y-You're a tough one to crack!

N-No, that's wrong!
I don't have a fetish or anything!

Tenko...you always take the conversation
too far. Maybe try calming down a little?

What do you know!?
I'm much calmer than before!
You're calmer than before?

Yeah... My parents told me I used to have
anger tantrums similar to an exploding volcano.

<CLT=cltMIND>A volcano?
How bad was she?

I guess my parents were pretty worried
about that.

They thought I wouldn't be able to fit into
society that way...

So they sent me to a temple to help discipline
my mind.
Where?
I see... Well, that's good
You have great parents
Are you unsure of something?

And as result of my training, I became the
calm and composed girl I am today!
Where?

Huuuh?
Are your eyes just decoration or something?

Geez, degenerates deny everything!
Do you think it's cool or something?

At this rate, you'll always be children.
Stuck in rebellious puberty for 10,000 years!

<CLT=cltMIND>I probably shouldn't
respond to this...
I see... Well, that's good.

Yeah, it's good I can casually talk to
people now.
It was that bad?

I thought I was talking normally before, but I
realized others couldn't tolerate me anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>...I could see that.
You have great parents.

Yeah. You don't hear this often from a child,
but I'm very grateful to my parents!

*gasp*! Are you praising my parents
to get my guard down!?
Ah, no, that's not it...

Yeah, but I'm sure my parents never expected
my accomplishment with the head priest.
We created <CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> together!

<CLT=cltMIND>...What? How does Aikido fit
into that at all?

During my mental training at the temple,
I called the head priest, "Master."
Cuz proper titles are necessary!

Master was very pleased about this and
added a new rule to the temple.

He declared that he was the Master of
martial arts!
Because he is just that important!
That important, huh?

We decided to create a martial arts Master
specialized in, and after reflecting on it...
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltNORMAL> was born!
That's...an odd origin story...
Argh! How dare you say that!?

Well, fine! New concepts are difficult for
people to accept anyway!

But one day, I'll make Neo-Aikido the national
sport! That's my dream!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Tenko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Still thinking about the origin of
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Neo-Aikido<CLT=cltMIND>, I returned to my room...
